entries.source:
* This skill only activates if you receive at least 1 XP from a foe death.
* The benefits gained can be identified by the dialogue bubbles above the character's head:
Boast "Buwahahaha!": Benefit: All conditions removed from self; Activation chance (%): 30%
Boast "Kneel Before Your Master!": Benefit: Double XP gained; Activation chance (%): 20%
Boast "Knowledge is Power!": Benefit: Healed for 50 health; Activation chance (%): 20%
Boast "You're No Match for My Brains!": Benefit: Gain 5 energy; Activation chance (%): 20%
Boast "Is There Anything I Can't Do?": Benefit: Recharge all skills; Activation chance (%): 10%

* Skills that require a morale boost, such as Resurrection Signet, Sunspear Rebirth Signet, and Celestial skills, are not recharged by "Is There Anything I Can't Do?".
* Experience scrolls stack with "Kneel Before Your Master".

Unlike other skills without an activation time, this skill has the standard aftercast delay of 0.75 second and cannot be used while moving or activating another skill.
entries.text:
只有從敵人死亡獲得至少 1 點經驗值時，此技能才會觸發。
可透過角色頭上的對話泡泡辨認獲得的效果：
「Buwahahaha!」：移除自身所有病症；觸發機率 30%。
「Kneel Before Your Master!」：獲得雙倍經驗值；觸發機率 20%。
「Knowledge is Power!」：恢復 50 點體力；觸發機率 20%。
「You're No Match for My Brains!」：獲得 5 點能量；觸發機率 20%。
「Is There Anything I Can't Do?」：使所有技能完成冷卻；觸發機率 10%。

需要士氣提升才能恢復使用的技能，例如復活紋章、Sunspear Rebirth Signet 及天界技能，不會因「Is There Anything I Can't Do?」而完成冷卻。
經驗值卷軸可與「Kneel Before Your Master」疊加。

此技能雖然沒有施放時間，卻與其他同類技能不同，仍有標準的 0.75 秒施放後延遲，且不能在移動或使用另一技能時施放。

entries.source:
*This skill mimics the effect of the Guild Lord's Amulet of Protection.
*Under Angelic Protection, you take the damage first and then are healed. If you take more damage than you have health remaining, you will die.
*Unlike Protective Spirit, this skill will protect even against small damage packets if there are enough of them. An example would be the large mobs of Avicara Fierce in Mineral Springs who use Ignite Arrows and Dual Shot.
*The effect of this skill isn't triggered by sacrificing health from skills such as Blood is Power.
[Source flags a skill functionality change]
Unlike most typeless skills with no activation time, this skill cannot be activated in the middle of another action and has a slight aftercast delay.
entries.text:
此技能模仿 Guild Lord 的 Amulet of Protection 效果。
受到天使守護保護時，你會先承受傷害，再獲得治療。若所受傷害超過剩餘體力，你仍會死亡。

entries.source:
* Combine Echo and Arcane Echo to create echo chains, allowing you to use three copies of any single skill.
* If the next skill after Arcane Echo is not a spell, this enchantment will end with no effect.
* Arcane Echo will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, the copy remains for 20 seconds, after which Arcane Echo is disabled for 20 seconds.
** Consider using Auspicious Incantation before Arcane Echo for energy management, since the recharge time will not be increased.
* If used to copy a spell that can copy another skill or spell, the copy duration of that spell is used and will bypass Arcane Echo's 20-second copy duration.
** E.g., if used to copy Echo, whatever skill that is copied by the Arcane Echo version of Echo will remain as that skill for 30 seconds and then revert back to Arcane Echo.
*Arcane Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the spell that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy Gift of Health, the copy is disabled by Gift of Health's effect afterwards.
Arcane Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy itself.

entries.text:
將回音與魔法回音搭配，可形成回音鏈，讓你使用同一技能的三個副本。
若使用魔法回音後的下一個技能不是咒文，此加持會結束且不產生效果。
只有在沒有複製咒文時，魔法回音才會正常冷卻。若成功複製，副本會保留 20 秒，之後魔法回音會停用 20 秒。
可考慮在魔法回音前使用幸運咒語補充能量，因為這種搭配不會增加實際冷卻時間。
若複製的咒文本身也能複製其他技能或咒文，會採用該咒文的複製持續時間，而不受魔法回音的 20 秒限制。
例如，用魔法回音複製回音後，該回音副本所複製的技能會保留 30 秒，然後還原為魔法回音。
魔法回音會先觸發複製，再套用觸發咒文的效果。例如複製體力贈予時，副本之後仍會被體力贈予的效果停用。
魔法回音的說明未提及它不能複製自己。

entries.source:
Order of damage modifiers
See: Order of damage modifiers
* Pain Inverter follows these general rules:
:* Damage dealt to the hexed foe is calculated before damage reduction effects such as Protective Spirit, but after the damage reduction from Armor of Salvation.
:* Does not apply to life draining skills such as Vampiric Bite.
:* Does not apply to Duncan's Defense or Shield of Fire.
:* Applies to passive damage skills such as Empathy, Backfire, or Clumsiness.
:* Applies to traps that cause direct damage, such as Spike Trap.
:* Applies to retaliation-based damage skills, e.g. Whirling Defense, Retribution, or Holy Wrath.

* The base damage is capped at 80, but there is no limit on total damage. Pain Inverter can deal more than 80 damage by using damage modifying skills, including Frenzy and the Lightbringer title.

Game mechanics
* Pain Inverter triggers multiple times if the hexed foe hits multiple targets; each time a creature is hit, the skill produces a separate packet of damage, each of which is capped at 80. This makes PI especially effective in these situations: 
:* Against high-damage area of effect (AoE) spells (base damage is capped at 80 per affected ally) — examples: Searing Flames and Earthquake.
:* Against damage over time (DoT) spells (base damage is capped at 80 per pulse) — examples: Searing Heat and Fire Storm. 
:* Against high-armor foes, especially bosses, since the damage ignores armor.
:* Against blocking skills that deal damage to attackers — examples: Whirling Defense, Flashing Blades, and Gladiator's Defense
:* Against foes using skills that generate extra packets of damage on attack — example: Ignite Arrows.

* An obvious way to take advantage of PI's mechanics is to provide the target with lots of fodder for AoE and DoT skills, e.g. by bringing minions, spirits, Asura Summons, Summoning Stones and/or animal companions.
entries.text:
傷害修正的套用順序
參見：Order of damage modifiers
* Pain Inverter 遵循下列一般規則：
:* 對受降咒敵人造成的傷害，在精神守護等減傷效果之前計算，但在 Armor of Salvation 的減傷之後計算。
:* 不適用於 Vampiric Bite 等吸取生命技能。
:* 不適用於 Duncan's Defense 或 Shield of Fire。
:* 適用於同理心、反噬或笨拙等被動造成傷害的技能。
:* 適用於尖刺陷阱等直接造成傷害的陷阱。
:* 適用於旋風防禦、報復或神聖憤怒等反擊傷害技能。

* 基礎傷害上限為 80，但總傷害沒有此上限。搭配狂暴態勢、光明使者稱號等傷害修正效果時，Pain Inverter 能造成超過 80 的傷害。

遊戲機制
* 受降咒敵人命中多個目標時，Pain Inverter 會觸發多次；每個生物被命中時，都會產生各自獨立的一次傷害，每次上限均為 80。因此，此技能尤其適合下列情況：
:* 對抗高傷害範圍法術：每名受影響盟友對應的基礎傷害上限為 80，例如爆裂火焰和地震。
:* 對抗持續傷害法術：每次傷害脈衝的基礎傷害上限為 80，例如灼熱之焰和火焰風暴。
:* 對抗高防禦敵人，尤其是 Boss，因為其傷害無視防禦。
:* 對抗會傷害攻擊者的格擋技能，例如旋風防禦、閃光利刃和角鬥士防禦態勢。
:* 對抗攻擊時產生額外傷害的技能，例如燃燒之箭。

* 利用此機制的直接方法，是讓目標的範圍及持續傷害技能能命中大量單位，例如攜帶不死生物、精靈、阿蘇拉召喚物、召喚石及／或動物夥伴。

* Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying bundles.
* Combines well with Item Spells that have an effect when dropped such as Protective Was Kaolai or Blind Was Mingson.
* Combines well with Binding Rituals since spirits will be maintained upon transformation and their attacks are affected by Ursan Roar.

Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.

* This skill takes effect as soon as damage is dealt. When triggered by an attack or skill that also applies a condition, that condition will be removed only if it is applied before the damage is dealt.
** Condition-applying attack skills and preparations apply their conditions after the attack damage is dealt; Weapon of Remedy will not remove these conditions.
** Enchantments such as Grenth's Grasp and Double Dragon which add a condition application to subsequent attacks or skills trigger before damage is dealt, allowing Weapon of Remedy to remove their conditions immediately if triggered by the same action.
** Some spells, such as Immolate, deal damage before applying their conditions, whereas others, such as Eruption, apply conditions first. [Research needed: Lots more skills to test, if it's worth doing so. See talk page]
